training_measurements.note: 80% of the run produced under 1% of the BPB improvement: 1.279 at step 400 to 1.270 at step 2000. The corpus was exhausted early.

throughput_reporting_bug.root_cause: cumulative tokens across all sessions divided by THIS session's elapsed time. The 1/n decay is the signature: a numerator that barely moves over a denominator growing linearly.
throughput_reporting_bug.fix: training/throughput.py — interval, session and run-wide reported separately

model_quality.interpretation: The corpus was procedural: words drawn independently from a fixed Zipfian distribution. It contains word boundaries, a frequency profile and sentence shape, but no syntax, no semantics and no long-range dependency. The optimal model for it predicts common words forever, which is what this one does. The low BPB and the degenerate generation are the same fact seen twice.

establishes: the hybrid architecture trains stably at ~100M on a 16 GB GPU
the training/checkpoint/resume/persistence stack is correct end to end
byte-level BPB works as a comparable optimisation target
~2090 tok/s on a T4 at seq 1024, batch 4, gradient checkpointing ON
does_not_establish: that the architecture can learn real-language structure
that 94.48M is a useful size for anything
anything about distillation, knowledge transfer or the teacher
